plugin.description: Inspect and restore interaction with client-resident portals.
settings.explanation: Restores selection and highlighting for portal entities still present in the client. Server entry restrictions still apply.
settings.experimental: Experimental: uses client memory writes. Current game-version behavior requires in-game verification.
settings.observe: With this switch off, only inspect portals; no new modifications are made. Switching it off attempts to undo this plugin's changes.
settings.export_path: Saved to Plugins/PortalAccess/config/portal-diagnostics.json. Counts report field writes, not successful map entries.
